values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 'Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period, then relocating the camp within five (5) road miles of the site just occupied without a waiting period of three weeks (21 days)') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: dispersed camping 'is free of charge anywhere in the national forest outside of a designated campground'; 'All vehicles must remain on or adjacent to roadways that are open to public travel'), read 2026-10-21

summary: No Forest Service page designates this site. Booking set from the Monongahela's dispersed-camping rules: first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28 (confirms reservable false / fcfs always; adds the 14-night limit). Free fee left (2023 forest notice). FS road layer: the pin is on NFSR 481 'Fish for Fun', rated suitable for passenger cars. No current Monongahela alert or forest order covers FR 209, 27, 47, 49, 233 or 481 (alerts page read 2026-10-21: closures are on FR 18, 19, 76, 86, 701 and a small Elk Run area). Not stated by any agency page: site count, rig size, facilities. Note left as is (AWH's firsthand road caveat).
flags: Aggregator link in website: https://thedyrt.com/camping/west-virginia/little-dispersed-site-by-railtracks. Missing agency page: no Forest Service page designates this site. The Monongahela's Camping & Cabins listing has no entry for it, and the Forest's list of developed-dispersed camping areas for the Greenbrier Ranger District (2023 release: Little River FR 17, Mower Tract FR 227/235, Stonecoal FR 209, West Fork FR 44) does not name it. Nearest official contact: Greenbrier District Bartow Office, (304) 456-3335 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/offices). The hookups/sites/facilities values rest on that Dyrt page (method reported).

Road / name, for information: Forest Service road layer (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RoadBasic_01/MapServer/0, queried 2026-10-21): the pin sits on NFSR 481 'FISH FOR FUN', operational maintenance level '3 - SUITABLE FOR PASSENGER CARS', crushed aggregate/gravel. FR 27 ('Gaudineer', level 4) lies about 3 km to the north-east, beside the FR 49 site (13222), not at this pin; so the name '(FR 27)' may be wrong (AWH's note already says the road is FR 27 or FR 481 depending on the map). The Forest Service's passenger-car rating differs from AWH's note ('may require high clearance'); no agency page recommends high clearance or 4WD, so no criteria flag. AWH's firsthand caveat kept.
